newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste and Waste Management close deal.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste and Waste Management close deal.

text.p: Canadian Waste Services, Inc, a subsidiary of USA Waste Services Inc and Waste Management Inc said Friday they have completed a previously announced transaction whereby Canadian Waste acquired most of Waste Management's Canadian solid waste assets.

In the transaction, Canadian Waste Services acquired for about US $180 million (about U.S. $120 million in cash and U.S. $60 million in USA Waste common stock) one landfill, 13 collection operations and three transfer stations providing service to more than 80,000 customers in the provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec.
USA Waste, based in Houston, Texas, is a non-hazardous solid waste management company serving customers in 36 states, the District of Columbia, Canada, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico and Mexico.
Waste Management is the world's largest provider of waste management services.
